description: KanbanFlow turns your Power BI report into a live Kanban or Scrum board — no separate tool, no data exports. Connect any SharePoint list, dataflow, or tabular data source and your work items appear as draggable cards, organised into swim lanes by stage or sprint column, great for project management. Key features: Live Kanban & Scrum board inside Power BI Aging indicators: cards and lanes colour by days in stage (green / amber / red) Due-date colour coding: cards turn amber when due soon, red when overdue Per-stage accent colours, font sizes, and layout presets from the Format pane KPI header: task count, stale items, active owners, completed rate Premium: write notes back to SharePoint via Power Automate, drag items between stages and sync the source list Tiers: Trial (unlimited time) · Basic (€12/mo) · Pro (€29/mo) · Premium (€59/mo) Licences are managed via ectrics.com — no per-seat Microsoft licence required.
